description: 100 curated science reasoning questions from ARC-Challenge

questions.question: A metal spoon left in a pot of boiling water becomes hot. Which process is primarily responsible for the heat transfer through the spoon?
An astronaut floating in the International Space Station pushes off a wall. What happens to the astronaut and the station?
choices: B) Both move in opposite directions
C) Neither moves because there is no gravity
D) Both move in the same direction

questions.question: A car accelerates from rest to 60 km/h in 10 seconds, then maintains that speed for 20 seconds. During which interval is the net force on the car greater?
choices: C) The net force is equal in both intervals
D) There is no net force in either interval

questions.question: When white light passes through a glass prism, it separates into a spectrum of colors. This occurs because different wavelengths of light are:
choices: A) absorbed at different rates by the glass
B) reflected at different angles inside the prism
C) diffracted by the edges of the prism
D) refracted by different amounts as they pass through the glass

questions.question: Two identical balls are dropped from the same height. Ball A falls in a vacuum, and Ball B falls through air. Which statement is true just before they hit the ground?
choices: A) Ball A has less kinetic energy than Ball B
B) Both balls have the same kinetic energy
C) Ball A has more kinetic energy than Ball B
D) Ball B has more potential energy than Ball A

questions.question: A student pushes a box across a rough floor at constant velocity. What can be concluded about the forces acting on the box?
choices: A) The applied force is greater than friction
D) The net force on the box is zero

choices: A) Kinetic energy to potential energy
B) Chemical energy to kinetic energy
C) Potential energy to kinetic energy
D) Thermal energy to kinetic energy

questions.question: Why does a helium balloon rise in air?
choices: A) Helium is attracted to the upper atmosphere
B) The buoyant force on the balloon exceeds its weight
C) Helium molecules repel air molecules
D) The balloon is pushed upward by air pressure from below only

questions.question: When iron is left outside in moist air, it gradually turns reddish-brown. This change is best described as:

B) a nuclear change in the iron atoms
C) a physical change in which iron dissolves
D) a chemical change in which iron reacts with oxygen and water
